MrEliptik Office low poly pack - greybox stand-in throwable props (docs/GDD.md: no packs ship; replace before store screenshots).
Source  : https://mreliptik.itch.io/office-low-poly-pack (office_pack.zip, downloaded 2026-11-13)
Licence : CC0 1.0, see LICENSE.txt. No credit required.
Changed : the pack ships GLB only, which Unity does not import here, so each model was converted to FBX with headless
          Blender (glTF import, each object's transform baked into its vertices so the root is unrotated at scale 1, FBX export
          with -Z forward, Y up). Shapes, sizes and materials are otherwise as published.
Left out: all_objects.glb (every model in one file) and desktop.glb / mousepad.glb (132-byte placeholder files in the zip, no mesh).
Heavy   : keyboard, keyboard_slim (93,342 triangles each) and laptop (94,772) model every key; too heavy to use as they are.
Scale   : not corrected. As published the monitor is 1.0 m wide, the chair 1.6 m tall and desk_big 3.1 m long.
Note    : written by Claude Fable 5.2 (Claude Code) on 2026-11-13 at Alex's request; not reviewed by a human.
